classification: Diagnostic grouping, not proof that every assertion has an identified root cause. The first matching group wins; child-process diagnostics remain attached to their parent test.

groupNotes.expiry_seam_or_extension_assertion: Not evidence of clock drift. Both expiry paths capture native identity before the Keep hook; non-Unix identity refusal can prevent extension or reaching the seam. Current tests now retain the underlying run result in assertion diagnostics.
groupNotes.access_denied: Directory-open failures and replacement of an existing open ledger are distinct operations. Opening directory handles alone would not implement the currently unsupported non-Unix identity checks.
